title: Bubbles tool-call evidence log entry
description: One JSONL line in .specify/runtime/tool-calls.jsonl. Records a single gate-relevant command invocation with provenance fields the evidence gate can verify deterministically. Schema v2 (v5.2) adds schemaVersion + framework provenance; readers MUST accept both v1 (no schemaVersion) and v2 entries.

schemaVersion.description: Record schema version. Absent or 1 = v5.1 shape. 2 = v5.2 shape (includes framework field). 3 = IMP-047 S-C shape (adds scenarioBinding, the receipt block that binds a command to a scenario, a claim, a source revision and an outcome). Readers MUST accept 1, 2 and 3.

framework.description: Bubbles framework provenance at time of record (v2+). Lets the evidence gate detect cross-version log entries.

name.description: Always 'bubbles' for entries written by the framework's tool-log.sh.

version.description: Bubbles framework VERSION at record time (e.g. '5.2.0').

sourceGitSha.description: Git SHA of the bubbles framework checkout that produced this entry, when resolvable.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the command completed.

sessionId.description: Opaque per-session identifier. Same session = same string across all entries; different sessions MUST differ.

agent.description: Name of the Bubbles agent (or 'human' / 'ci') that invoked the command.

spec.description: Spec slug (e.g. '042-feature-name') the command relates to. Empty for framework-level commands.

scope.description: Scope identifier within the spec, when applicable.

cmd.description: The literal command line executed (post-shell-expansion, pre-redirection). Used for matching against DoD-recorded command claims.

exitCode.description: Process exit code. Evidence gates treat exitCode=0 as PASS unless the DoD item explicitly expects failure.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds. Optional but recommended.

stdoutHash.description: sha256 of captured stdout. Used to detect copy-paste fabrication across evidence blocks.

stdoutBytes.description: Size of captured stdout in bytes.

stderrBytes.description: Size of captured stderr in bytes.

inputClosure.description: Declared input files hashed at record time (IMP-024). A later change to a declared input invalidates exactly this receipt.

scenarioBinding.description: IMP-047 S-C receipt block. Present only when this command was recorded AS EVIDENCE for a named scenario. It is what makes the entry admissible: without it the entry records that a command ran, which is not the same as proving a claim. The binding contract lives in bubbles/registry/scenario-states.yaml.

scenarioId.description: The stable SCN-* id this receipt is evidence for.

phase.description: Receipt phase, matching a receiptPhase declared in bubbles/registry/scenario-states.yaml.

testIdentity.description: Identity of the test that ran. RED and GREEN must cite the SAME value; substituting the test is a different claim, not a repaired one.

sourceRevision.description: Source revision the receipt was recorded against. Drift invalidates the receipt, because a receipt proves what the tree was, not what it is.

negativeControl.description: The perturbation that makes this test fail. Required for state derivation; a test with no stated control has not been shown to be sensitive to the behavior it claims to prove.

claim.description: The claim this receipt substantiates, in the words of the DoD item or scenario it is offered for. This is what replaces token overlap in the Check 9 admission path: the claim must COVER the DoD item, and the DoD item must POINT AT this scenario.

implementationRefs.description: Production paths the change touched. A CHANGED implementation ref marks every scenario governing it AFFECTED.
